desc:
PREPPED: Delicious tomatoes cooked down into a rich, flavorful paste

MADE WITH ORGANIC TOMATOES: USDA Certified Organic and Non-GMO Project Verified

EASY MEAL ADDITION: Store your organic tomato paste in the pantry for soups, stews and pizza

WHOLESOME INGREDIENTS: Quality tomatoes with no cholesterol

SERVINGS: About 5 servings per container
features:
Features

Certified Organic – Made from vine-ripened tomatoes grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers.

Non-GMO Project Verified – Ensures the product is free from genetically modified ingredients.

Double-Concentrated – Rich and thick consistency to add intense tomato flavor with just a small amount.

Clean Ingredients – Contains only organic tomato paste and citric acid; no added sugar, salt, or preservatives.

Low Sodium & Zero Fat – About 25 mg sodium per serving; completely fat-free and cholesterol-free.

Good Source of Potassium & Iron – Offers nutritional support with essential minerals.

Kosher & Gluten-Free – Safe for a variety of dietary needs and restrictions.

Eco-Conscious Brand – Muir Glen practices organic and sustainable farming.

Benefits

Bold, Authentic Tomato Flavor – Enhances the taste of sauces, stews, soups, and pasta with a deep tomato richness.

Healthier Cooking Option – No added sugars, fats, or artificial additives—great for clean eating.

Versatile Ingredient – Ideal for everyday cooking, from pizza sauce to chili bases and marinades.

Easy to Store and Use – Compact can size perfect for recipes that call for a small amount.

Supports Sustainable Agriculture – Buying supports environmentally friendly farming methods.

Allergy-Friendly – Suitable for those avoiding gluten, dairy, and common allergens.
